title: finance.billing.payment.received
description: A payment was recorded and allocated to one or more invoices. Append-only. `received_date` is the business date the money arrived. `currency` is the allocated invoices' common currency: a payments row has no currency column of its own, so the producer derives it, and must refuse an allocation that mixes currencies.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I2): services/finance/app/services.py:record_payment does not emit received_date, method, currency yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
